prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 equal 2x2 studio portrait grid of one original adult woman who does not resemble a public figure. She has an extreme auburn 1990s supermodel blowout with deep side part and visible flyaways, piercing blue eyes, natural pores, freckles, and unretouched skin. She wears a covered high-neck long-sleeve sequin top in iridescent black, deep violet, and magenta, a rigid gold-tone collar necklace, and plain mixed-metal bangles. Show four consistent panels: intense frontal close-up, cheek on closed fist with slight smirk, chin on open palm with soft smile, and candid laughing profile. Use hard direct studio flash, ivory background, medium-format 80mm f/2.8 character, Portra 400-inspired grain, slight chromatic aberration, and no text, logos, or watermarks.
